verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source agent library, and a training-data privacy posture is a fair question for agent frameworks, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy, or opt-out that prevents user data from being used for AI model training. Support for running local models (transformers/ollama) is a user-side choice of model provider, not a product-provided training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
